statement: The contracts/ BrowserVM and deploy-gate tests (contracts/test/vm/<area>/*.test.ts, contracts/test/gate/*.test.ts) run inside the one gate, one file per process after a rebuild that leaves the committed typechain-types as they were: `bun rules/check.ts` (and --contracts-only) is red when one is red, when the rebuild fails or changes typechain-types, or when no test file is found, and CI's contracts job runs that same command.
source: coordinator 10-01 08:48 (a contracts/test/gate test went red on GitHub only: the local gate checked where such tests sit but never ran them)

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules and CI); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a red contracts/ BrowserVM or deploy-gate test, or a stale typechain, alone is 1
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a red gate test of contracts/ exits 1 and names the file
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM the same test passing, with a quiet rebuild, passes the contracts part
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a rebuild that writes into typechain-types exits 1 as stale
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM the files are CI's globs: vm/<area>/*.test.ts and gate/*.test.ts, sorted, nothing else
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a tree with no gate test is red, not an empty pass
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a green rebuild and green tests pass, the build first and each test file in a process of its own
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a red test file is named with its exit code and the end of its output, and the other files still run
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a test that did not start is red, not skipped
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a failing rebuild is red and says so
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM a rebuild that changes typechain-types is red: the committed files are stale
R-GATE-CONTRACTS-VM the digest is the same for the same files and differs for a changed, an added and a renamed file
